verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an incident-management platform, but no evidence item documents assignable incident roles such as incident commander or comms lead, or task checklists attached to incidents. Incident Workflows (if-this-then-that automation), escalation policies, and the Scribe Agent's recording of action items are adjacent features. They do not provide defined response roles or checklists.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, incidents carry defined roles (commander, comms lead) and task checklists so response stays coordinated under pressure
